name: Backend Cowork→Code
description: Workflow backend Cowork → Code (docs-first, không pipeline bắt buộc): backend-init scaffold cấu trúc thư mục + tài liệu nền (project-knowledge, ADR, data-model/ERD, layout src theo kiến trúc chọn khi init); recipe on-demand: backend-implement (vertical slice theo kiến trúc), backend-testing (test theo tầng), backend-code-review (review diff/PR), backend-refactor (giữ nguyên hành vi), backend-migrate-architecture (Onion/Hexagonal/CQRS/layered), backend-migrate-vault-consul (config/secret sang Vault/Consul), backend-api-contract (OpenAPI-first, kiểm drift).
